name: Toolkit
insp: playful product launch sites and bento-grid app pages
desc: Built for small business owners. The headline springs in letter by letter beside the isometric brand tiles; scroll and the page pins while seven service tiles spring out of an isometric pile into a bento grid. Three questions make the right tiles jump to the front and fill in the enquiry.
fx: Service tiles spring from an isometric pile into the grid as you scroll
Headline letters spring in one by one
Tiles tilt and lean toward your cursor, with photos shifting inside
Three questions make the suggested tiles jump to the front with a green ring
The five promises slide past in a pinned sideways row
Tax date tiles flip down into place
